article.title: The culture that is Cornwall
article.excerpt: Cornwall has issued an urgent plea for reassurance that it will not be worse off following the Brexit vote. The county has received a “significant amounts” of funding from the EU for the past 15 years due to its “relatively weak economy”. But, after 56.5% of voters in the county chose to leave the Union, the council says it is now seeking urgent reassurance
